title: UNREAL EDITOR FOR FORTNITE! | Copi Cafe Episode 47 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode of Copi Cafe, the guys kick the conversation off with some speculation on mass adoption relating to the all new Unreal Engine for Fortnite. Josh then goes on to explain some news about a partnership Cornucopias has formed with Machinations and how they will benefit the main game. The guys then talk about some new updates to the racing game and then the current meme contest taking place. They then go on to answer two new community questions asked by our community on Discord. Finally, the guys share an all new leak! 

00:00 Beverage Choices
02:35 Mass Adoption 
09:15 Machinations
13:19 Racing Game Updates
18:59 Meme Contest
20:54 Community Questions
26:58 Leaks!
